# Where to Watch THE SPY NEXT DOOR


by Angel | October 29, 2026


What happens when a highly trained secret agent gets stuck babysitting three unruly kids?


For Bob Ho, keeping his neighbors’ kids safe should be easy compared to the missions he’s used to. But when the kids accidentally blow his cover, Bob’s quiet life in the suburbs turns into anything but ordinary.


Now he has to take on assassins, double agents, and dangerous villains—all while trying to keep the kids out of trouble.


[Watch The Spy Next Door now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/spy-next-door)


### **Jackie Chan Has a New Assignment**


Bob Ho is used to dangerous missions. He’s a highly trained spy who knows how to outsmart villains, escape impossible traps, and handle just about anything that comes his way.


Then he agrees to babysit.


The kids aren’t exactly cooperative, and things get even more complicated when they accidentally download secret codes from Bob’s computer. Suddenly, his identity is at risk, dangerous enemies are closing in, and Bob has to protect his young charges while keeping them from turning every situation into complete chaos.


It’s a lot to handle—even for a spy.


### **Three Kids. One Secret Agent.**


With Bob’s cover blown, the suburban neighborhood becomes the unlikely setting for an action-packed adventure.


Bob fights off assassins, takes on arch villains, dodges traps, and tries to stay one step ahead of double agents. Meanwhile, the kids are right in the middle of it all.


The result is a mix of Jackie Chan’s signature stunts and physical comedy with plenty of family-friendly chaos.


### **More Than Just the Action**


While the stunts and comedy keep the adventure moving, *The Spy Next Door* also has a surprisingly wholesome heart.


Bob’s relationship with the kids gives him a chance to step into a role he’s not accustomed to, and the kids learn a few lessons of their own along the way.


Angel Guild viewers have called it “a good classic family fun film” and praised its clean humor, action, and heart. One viewer said it was a movie they would happily watch again with their family, while another highlighted its message about telling the truth and facing the consequences of lies.


It’s the kind of movie that doesn’t take itself too seriously while still giving families something positive to enjoy together.


### **Watch** ***The Spy Next Door*** **on Angel**


If you’re looking for a family movie with plenty of laughs, action, and Jackie Chan charm, *The Spy Next Door* makes for an easy pick.


Because when three kids accidentally uncover a secret agent’s identity, babysitting becomes a whole lot more dangerous—and a whole lot more fun.
